steps.hardClue: Restore power, activate the accelerator and assemble the upgrade machine in the other dimension.
steps.clue: Restore power, activate the Particle Accelerator and build Pack-a-Punch in the Dark Aether.

steps.hardClue: Build the viewing device, give the diary to three spectral reflections and enter the password.
steps.clue: Build the Aetherscope, give Vogel’s diary to the three spectral reflections and enter the password.

steps.hardClue: Obtain the Wonder Weapon and use its four variants on the matching colored ports.
steps.clue: Obtain the D.I.E. Shockwave and use its elemental upgrades on the matching containment-unit ports.

steps.hardClue: Witness the medical-room reflection, then collect the wrench it leaves behind.
steps.clue: Witness the Medical Bay reflection, then collect the Dark Aether Wrench.

steps.hardClue: Use the wrench on the tank, then make it fire to recover the containment agent.
steps.clue: Use the Dark Aether Wrench on the tank, then make it fire to recover the Decontamination Agent.

steps.hardClue: Trap both halves of the special enemy inside the containment unit, then start the process.
steps.clue: Trap both Megaton halves inside the Containment Unit, then begin the decontamination process.

steps.hardClue: Enter the alternate dimension and recover the family photograph.
steps.clue: Enter the Dark Aether and recover Orlov’s family photograph.

steps.hardClue: Defend the scientist while he shuts down the accelerator.
steps.clue: Defend Orlov as he shuts down the Particle Accelerator.

steps.hardClue: Escape the facility while avoiding electrical surges, then reach the helicopter.
steps.clue: Escape Projekt Endstation while avoiding electrical surges, then board the exfil helicopter.
